title: Grok sends its own hook payload, and its docs are on this machine
body: Grok Build's hook payload is camelCase (sessionId, toolName, toolInput, toolResult, stopHookActive) with its own tool names (read_file with path; search_replace with file_path, old_string, new_string; run_terminal_command); only a hook matcher maps Claude Code's names to Grok's. PreToolUse additionalContext reaches the model after the call, a UserPromptSubmit hook's context is discarded, and Stop also fires at session end with reason shutdown. The guide is local at ~/.grok/docs/user-guide/10-hooks.md; field names it omits were read from grok.exe's serde strings. src/hooks/grok.cjs maps it; no real session was recorded (no credits on 2026-10-22).
not_derivable: Grok's guide lives outside the repository, and the binary field names were found by searching the executable; nothing in the code says where the mapping came from or that it is unconfirmed.
